newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba director calls for stricter risk management.
newsitem.headline: Buba director calls for stricter risk management.

text.p: German banks should improve their risk management and increase transparency in their derivatives trading, Bundesbank board member Edgar Meister said on Saturday.
In an essay published in the Boersen Zeitung newspaper, Meister said daily, or even constant observation and active direction of trading positions is indispensable.
"Risks must remain manageable for banks if they are not to endanger the stability of the bank and potentially the financial system itself," Meister wrote.

Meister endorsed efforts by the International Securities Market Association to create a network of data banks of historical price data, and said German credit institutes should attempt something similar.
